title: RSVP with flankers - sentences with semantic and syntactic violations
description: EEG dataset recorded during rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) of sentences with flanking words, in which the critical center word was shown between grey flanker words. Sentences contained subject-verb agreement violations, semantic violations, double violations, word-order violations, or no violation (controls). The dataset supports research on sentence processing and parafoveal word processing during reading.
methods_description: Participants sat in a darkened, sound-attenuated room, viewing an LCD monitor at 152 cm, and responded with a keyboard and a headset for verbal responses. They read 180 sentences (30 each of agreement, semantic, double and word-order violations, plus 60 control sentences). Three words were shown at a time in an RSVP-with-flankers design: the white center word was flanked by grey words, each word appeared for 400 ms and slid to the right, and there was no ISI.
